"Build a complete, fully functional, premium web-based football manager game called \"Touchline '26\" (Soccer Manager 2026) using React, Vite, Node.js backend, and Tailwind CSS. 

The game must feature a professional dark-mode UI inspired by modern football management games, featuring a dark green and sleek slate color palette.

### Core Features @COMMENT_BODY@ Screens to Include:
1. **Dashboard (Home):**
   - Club overview greeting the manager (e.g., \"Good Evening, Alex\")[span_0](start_span)[span_0](end_span).
   - Boardroom stats: Available club funds (€32.0M), wage bills, current league position (1st), and team overall rating (OVR 77.5)[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span).
   - Next fixture match preview card displaying home and away team badges, team ratings, and win probability bar (e.g., 66% / 24% / 10%), alongside an \"Enter match day\" button.

2. **Navigation Menu (Sidebar / Bottom Nav):**
   - Fully working tabs and routes for: Dashboard, Squad, Match Day, Transfer Market, Facilities, and League Table[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span).

3. **League Table @COMMENT_BODY@ Competitions:**
   - Real-time standings table tracking matches played, goal difference, points, and recent form guide[span_3](start_span)[span_3](end_span).

4. **Squad @COMMENT_BODY@ Tactics:**
   - Interactive formation view (e.g., 4-2-3-1 or 4-3-3), player lists, ratings, morale, and fitness indicators.

5. **Transfer Market:**
   - List of available players with values, positions, and buttons to place bids or buy players using club funds.

### Technical Requirements:
- Use clean, modular React components.
- Ensure Tailwind CSS classes are properly configured via standard CDN or PostCSS without failing module lookups.
- Make sure the local development server starts cleanly with `npm run dev` and renders the game immediately in the Live/Preview tab without triggering any build loops or missing dependency crashes.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@6f6d1b7b9bdb480e4ef1c32fd5b0fca8814a9003
    with:
      runtime_ref: 6f6d1b7b9bdb480e4ef1c32fd5b0fca8814a9003

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@6f6d1b7b9bdb480e4ef1c32fd5b0fca8814a9003
    with:
      runtime_ref: 6f6d1b7b9bdb480e4ef1c32fd5b0fca8814a9003
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

function buildFullSchedule() {
  const ids = TEAMS.map((team) => team.id)
  const fixed = ids[0]
  const rest = ids.slice(1)
  const n = rest.length
  const firstHalf = []

  for (let round = 0; round < n; round += 1) {
    const pairs = []
    const fixedHome = round % 2 === 0
    pairs.push(fixedHome ? [fixed, rest[round % n]] : [rest[round % n], fixed])
    for (let i = 1; i <= Math.floor(n / 2); i += 1) {
      const a = rest[(round + i) % n]
      const b = rest[(round - i + n) % n]
      pairs.push(i % 2 === 0 ? [b, a] : [a, b])
    }
    firstHalf.push(pairs)
  }

  const secondHalf = firstHalf.map((pairs) => pairs.map(([home, away]) => [away, home]))
  return [...firstHalf, ...secondHalf]
}

const BASE_DATE = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 14, 15, 0, 0) // Sat 14 Nov 2026, 15:00 UTC
const ALL_ROUNDS = buildFullSchedule()

export const INITIAL_FIXTURES = ALL_ROUNDS.flatMap((pairs, index) => {
  const round = index + 1
  if (round < START_MATCHDAY) return []
  return pairs.map(([homeId, awayId], matchIndex) => {
    const isSunday = matchIndex === 8 || matchIndex === 9
    const date = new Date(BASE_DATE + (round - START_MATCHDAY) * 7 * 86_400_000 + (isSunday ? 86_400_000 : 0) + matchIndex * 20 * 60_000)
    return {
      id: `r${round}-${homeId}-${awayId}`,
      round,
      homeId,
      awayId,
      date: date.toISOString(),
      played: false,
      homeGoals: null,
      awayGoals: null,
    }
  })
})

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete playable premium football manager game “Touchline '26” with React, Vite, Node backend, and Tailwind, covering Dashboard, Squad, Match Day, Transfers, Facilities, and League Table.

## Requirements
- Professional dark-mode UI with dark green and sleek slate palette.
- Dashboard: manager greeting, board stats (€32.0M funds, wage bill, 1st position, OVR 77.5), next-fixture preview with badges, ratings, win probability bar, and Enter Match Day button.
- Routes for Dashboard, Squad, Match Day, Transfer Market, Facilities, League Table.
- League table with played, GD, points, and recent form.
- Interactive formation view (4-2-3-1/4-3-3), ratings, morale, fitness.
- Transfer list with values, positions, bids and purchases using funds.
- Clean modular React; Tailwind via PostCSS; `npm run dev` must start cleanly and render immediately.
- Save small JPEG screenshots at ≤1280px and inspect only the latest.
- Do not ask clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Used fictional clubs/players to avoid licensing; user club is Ashcombe United, manager Alex Mercer.
- Tailwind CSS v3 via PostCSS, not CDN, to avoid module lookup failures.
- Used HashRouter so production/static deployment works without server rewrites.
- Added localStorage persistence plus optional Express save API at `/api/save`; frontend works fully static.
- Game state is client-side; match simulation and transfers operate immediately.
- Changed season fixture base date to Saturday 9 Jan 2027 so “Winter window” and 31 Jan deadline are coherent.
- Adjusted Declan Marsh to 76 and staff wages to €394k so starting OVR is 77.5 and wage bill is €1.84M.

## Work State
### Completed
- Scaffolded Vite/React/Tailwind project and installed dependencies.
- Built full game data (`src/data/gameData.js`), live match engine (`src/lib/engine.js`), formatting helpers (`src/lib/format.js`), reducer/context (`src/context/GameContext.jsx`).
- Built shared UI system, team crests, player avatars, toasts, modals, player profile modal, responsive layout/sidebar/mobile nav/global search.
- Built all six pages: Dashboard, Squad, MatchDay, Transfers, Facilities, League.
- Match simulation works with live commentary, stats, halftime team talk, tactical changes, skip-to-full-time, result screen, table/funds/player-stat updates.
- Transfers work with bid modal, sign-at-asking, budget deductions, squad additions, toast feedback.
- Facilities upgrades and training focus work with fund deductions.
- League table and fixtures/results tabs work; table updates after each matchday.
- Express backend implemented with `/api/health`, `/api/save` GET/POST/DELETE.
- Production build succeeds: `npm run build`.
- Dev server runs on port 3000 via `npm run dev`; API on 3001; verified with curl.
- Desktop screenshots checked for Dashboard, Squad, Match Day preview/live/halftime/result, Transfers, Facilities, League, League fixtures.
- Fixed result toast score ordering, OVR/wage display, sidebar ordinal/date, facility copy.

### Active
- Polishing transfer “Priority target” card, which currently has excessive empty space because it stretches to match the deal-room card.
- Need to verify the latest date changes and rebuilt app via a fresh localStorage clear.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Enrich the Transfer Market priority-target card with a bottom stats/scout-verdict section and ensure it fills the card height.
2. Rebuild (`npm run build`) and restart/verify `npm run dev` if needed.
3. Clear localStorage in Playwright, reload, and recheck Dashboard/Transfers/Facilities/League for regressions from the Jan 2027 date changes.
4. Inspect mobile layout at ~390px width and fix any bottom-nav/table overflow issues.
5. Test a transfer purchase end-to-end and a facilities upgrade end-to-end, checking funds, squad, wage bill, and persistence.
6. Verify production static build still renders through the runtime/default-start flow.
7. Final pass on console errors and unused imports; provide brief final summary with assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `src/data/gameData.js`: teams, squads, transfer targets, fixtures, facilities, dates, formations.
- `src/lib/engine.js`: lineup selection, table sorting, probabilities, live/quick match simulation, ratings, attributes.
- `src/context/GameContext.jsx`: initial state, reducer for matches/signings/upgrades, persistence.
- `src/pages/Dashboard.jsx`: hero, KPI cards, next fixture, form, league snapshot, news.
- `src/pages/Squad.jsx`: formation pitch, lineup/bench swap, tactics, full player table.
- `src/pages/MatchDay.jsx`: preview, live match, halftime talk, result screen.
- `src/pages/Transfers.jsx`: marquee card, filters, table, bid/sign modal (next polish target).
- `src/pages/Facilities.jsx`: stadium hero, facility upgrades, training focus.
- `src/pages/League.jsx`: standings, fixtures/results, title race, stats.
- `src/components/Layout.jsx`: sidebar, topbar, mobile bottom nav, global search/notifications.
- `src/components/ui.jsx`: cards, buttons, badges, bars, rings, sparkline, form pips.
- `src/index.css`: fonts, Tailwind layers, background, sliders, scrollbars.
- `server/index.js`: Express API and optional static dist serving.
- `screenshots/`: latest desktop screenshots, including `transfers.jpg`, `league-fixtures.jpg`, `facilities.jpg`, `match-result.jpg`.

## Important Context
- Dev command: `npm run dev`; Vite port 3000, Express API port 3001, proxy `/api`.
- Build command: `npm run build`; production output `dist/`.
- `playwright-cli` must be used with a cleared localStorage to see changed seed data: `playwright-cli eval "() => { localStorage.clear(); return 'cleared' }"`, then `reload`.
- Latest screenshots are 1280×900 JPEGs; read only the newest.
- A live dev session is running in tmux session `touchline`, log at `/tmp/touchline-dev.log`.
- Current local browser save reflects one simulated 3–2 win over Riverton, so fresh-state screenshots require clearing localStorage.
- Known potential polish items: Dashboard KPI detail text can wrap tightly; mobile pages not yet inspected; halftime Resume button remains enabled before choosing a team talk.

Built **Touchline '26** — a complete, playable football manager game with a premium dark green/slate interface.

### What's included
- **Dashboard** — manager greeting, board KPIs (€32.0M budget, €1.84M wage bill, 1st place, 77.5 OVR), next fixture with win probability, form, league snapshot, and club news.
- **Squad** — interactive 4-2-3-1 / 4-3-3 pitch, lineup swapping, ratings, morale, fitness, tactics, and full player table.
- **Match Day** — pre-match preview, live minute-by-minute engine, commentary, stats, tactical changes, half-time team talk, skip-to-full-time, and full-time report. Results update the table, funds, and player stats.
- **Transfer Market** — enriched priority-target card, filters, sorting, search, bid negotiation, sign-at-asking, budget deductions, and squad integration.
- **Facilities** — stadium, training, medical, youth, and scouting upgrades plus training focus, all deducted from club funds.
- **League Table** — standings, form, fixtures/results, title race, and season statistics.

### Technical notes
- React + Vite + Tailwind CSS v3 via PostCSS, HashRouter for static deployment.
- Express API at `/api/health` and `/api/save` with optional static `dist` serving.
- Game progress persists to localStorage and the save API.
- Fictional clubs and players avoid licensing issues; Ashcombe United, managed by Alex Mercer.
- Season dates are aligned to a **9 January 2027** start with a **31 January** winter deadline.

### Verified
- `npm run build` succeeds.
- `npm run dev` serves the app cleanly on port 3000.
- Production `npm start` renders through the built `dist`.
- Desktop and mobile layouts checked at 1280px and 390px; fixed a league-page horizontal overflow and removed unused imports.
- Transfer purchase and facilities upgrade tested end-to-end, including funds, squad, wage bill, and persistence.
- No console errors.
